About R.A.P MOULD

A mold engineering company built on four decades of hands-on experience, where every key project is guided directly by a senior mold engineer.

Our story

Founded on Engineering, Driven by Precision

Rahkar Andishan Pars Ghaleb (R.A.P MOULD) was founded in 2019 to bring a new standard of service to industrial mold design and engineering. Our credibility rests on something no marketing can buy: deep technical knowledge and more than forty years of engineering experience in the mold-making industry, earned by Mr. Davoud Sadr al-Zakerin across 100+ diverse, successfully completed projects.

We combine the experience of generations with current methods and technologies to deliver innovative, optimized solutions for our customers' most complex production challenges.

Our mission goes beyond building molds. By deeply understanding production processes and each industry's unique needs, we create lasting value and competitive advantage for our business partners. Uncompromising precision, superior quality, and on-time delivery are the pillars of our work, and your guarantee of satisfaction.

Profile
